title: SendGrid stops sending on an old free account and new signups get only a 60-day trial
symptoms: Mail Send fails on an account that ran on the free plan for years
Dashboard asks for a paid plan before sending resumes
Contacts list emptied on a former free Marketing Campaigns account
cause: Twilio retired the free Email API and Marketing Campaigns plans starting 2025-05-27, kept them working for 60 days, then paused sending on free accounts. Free accounts with more than 100 stored contacts had all contacts deleted.
fix: Move production senders to a paid Email API plan, and do not build new projects on a SendGrid free tier that no longer exists.
apply: SendGrid console > Settings > Account Details > Your Products > Email API > Change Plan
affected: SendGrid free Email API and free Marketing Campaigns plans, retired from 2025-05-27 with sending paused about 60 days later
